notes.title: A quick small update to 0.5.4a
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we've rolled out a small update to version 0.5.4, or rather, 0.5.4a. Although it doesn't include new gameplay content, we've tackled several bugs that (we believe) we've resolved, and we wanted to release the fix as soon as possible. Due to these bugs, we also delayed making the new (previous) version available to our $1 Patrons, so today's version is immediately available for download here as well.

We've incremented the version number because we're introducing some of the changes planned for the next version. It's a bit convoluted, but hopefully, you understand!
Added
System

Dsiplay mode select in main menu - you can change between windowed and a full screen modes in the main menu now just by pressing a button (a lot of people asked for this)

Orgasm balance - girls now have their liked and very liked sex positions. Their arousal levels will rise at different rates in different positions. This makes it possible to bring them to orgasms at an intimacy level of 3 or even 2 (with lubrication).

Skill map update - Initially, we thought there would be fewer animated scenes in the game and more unlockable positions, but the proportions have reversed. By version 1.0, we plan to limit ourselves to 10 positions. So we updated the map's appearance and limited the number of icons to avoid misleading anyone.
Changed
Fixes, fixes, fixes... We hope we managed to fix all the major bugs and you will now be able to play without problems.



Thank you for all your feedback, reported bugs and for being with us. See you soon in the next post!

notes.title: Big Demo Update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

New demo version has been released! There's a lot of changes in the new version, that's why we recommend starting from the beginning. And that's why you won't see your previous save files in it. But if you REALLY want to continue where you left off in the previous demo, we can tell you how to bring your old files into the new game (it is possible, though we cannot guarantee that everything will work flawlessly). 

Note: The demo will end after you complete the quest 010 (that starts soon after you complete quests 007 and 009), so you may want to use manual save option if you'd like to go back.

What's new? Here's the full changelog between v 0.4.0 and v 0.5.0

Changelog
Added:
Story/Gameplay

 Quests

 Quest 003 can be completed 
 Quest 005 can be completed
 Quest 007
 Quest 008 is received, but CANNOT be completed (nothing will happen)
 Quest 009
 Quest 010

 Note: Quest 006 still CANNOT be completed (nothing will happen)


 Morning meetings and daily work

 The team will have some team bonding - talking about quests you have finished the day before, if there were any
 On day 4 you will be told you have to learn how to do the last job - room cleaning 
 From day 5 you can choose where you want to work that day (or if you want a day off)

 Room Cleaning shift
 After completing quest 004 - the store's decor changes (full shelves) and permanent items appear in the stock

 Note: tools and the sleeping accessories won't unlock more content now

 Girls' placement system 

 Instead of always staying in one place, the girls will now be spread out around the hotel, depending on the work we choose for the day. To make it easier to keep track, a table will now appear during job selection, showing where each girl will be placed that day. Additionally they may spend free time in their rooms.

 Missionary sex position

 skill point can be exchanged to unlock next position on the skill map - the missionary.


Extras/Art

 Pixel Art of three new characters, dialogue portraits for two of them
 NPC's now enjoying drinks on the benches by the beach
 New map in the forest (upper right corner of the current forest map)

Features and system

 Gallery 
 Steam Deck support improved
 Steam Cloud support

Changed:

 Front desk shift

 Changed the layout of the PC with the schedule, and now NPCs ask more varied questions (on weather, hotel information or currency rates)

 Bar shift

 Adaptive tempo - how fast new guests come in depends on how quick is the player mixing the drinks

 Energy system

 Locked nights - at night you go automatically to bed. You need to buy an permanent item from the store to be able to walk around at night (item available after quest 004)
 Full recovery - nights restore your whole energy bar
 Changed energy cost - actions energy cost is more varied. Some actions will also take energy but won't take time
 Work energy cost - the energy required for work will be deducted when you select a job during the morning meeting, so you don’t have to worry about running out of it later.

 Dexterity is now called Fitness
 Girs' "Personal Favorites" listed in the Girls Menu
 Mouse control improvements
 Many, many, many bug fixes and general improvements


We hope you'll enjoy the new version and as always, we wait for your feedback! Please let us know if you like the new content, either by leaving a review or a message in the discussion group. You can also connect with us on our Discord server, or support us on Patreon (and get the access to more content!).

notes.title: Demo Update incoming! Version 0.4.8 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that the demo version of Komadori Inn will soon be updated to version 0.5.0! This update not only fixes several bugs from the previous version but also significantly extends the gameplay experience. Unlike before, the gameplay won't be time-limited; it will conclude only after you've completed the available quests, allowing you to play up to quest 010.

We still have a lot of work ahead of us to complete the game, and we're excited to share this larger piece of Komadori Inn with you. We hope you enjoy the extended gameplay as much as you did the first three days at Komadori Inn! 

We are currently testing the new demo and will most likely release the update early next week.

In the meantime, our patrons received the 0.4.8 update today!

Version 0.4.8 Highlights


 Steam Deck and Steam Cloud Support: This version primarily introduces the previously mentioned support for Steam Deck and Steam Cloud. This means playing Komadori Inn on the go should be seamless, and your game saves are securely stored in the cloud, following you wherever you play.
 Shun's Storyline Continuation: You can now continue Shun's storyline with quest 014! Discover why Shun is still in a bad mood despite her aunt's departure, introduce a special guest to the hotel, and most importantly, unlock the third Intimacy Level and the standing missionary position.
 Girls' Menu Update: We've made a small change in the "Girls" menu tab. Initially, some fun facts about them (like favorite food, favorite activity, etc.) were supposed to be unlocked over time, but we've decided to fill them in right away. Just a little tidbit about our main love interests.
 Bug Fixes and Improvements: This new version also brings a multitude of fixes and enhancements.


Changelog:
Added:
System

 Steam Deck support
 Steam Cloud support

Story/Gameplay

 Quest 014
 Beginning of the Quest 017 (not finished)
 Shun's Intimacy Level 3

Changed

 Girs' "Personal Favorites" listed in the Girls Menu
 Updated Thai and Chinese translations
 Many, many fixes


Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new update! And if you're interested in getting the early access, check out our Patreon!

Best, Macamagucha

notes.title: V 0.4.7 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we approach the end of April, we're thrilled to announce the release of a new version of Komadori Inn to our Patrons, v 0.4.7! This update brings exciting new features and content that we can't wait for you to experience.

 Gallery: The gallery allows you to review all the story scenes you've unlocked. Patrons can now use the "T" key to unlock all existing scenes, so you won't have to replay the game from the beginning to access them.
 New Quest: This update introduces a new quest that not only advances the story but also unlocks a new features.
 Third Intimacy Level with Fuyuko: Completing the quest above will allow you to reach the third Intimacy Level with Fuyuko, unlocking her new perk—the ability to change outfits. This means you can dress and undress her during sex scenes
 New Position: Standing Missionary: The quest also awards you with another skill point you can use to unlock this position. Utilize the tables and desks in the hotel to enjoy the standing missionary. 

As always, please remember that this is an alpha version, and your feedback is invaluable to us. We encourage you to report any bugs or issues you encounter so we can continue to improve the game.

Changelog
Added
Features

 Gallery

Story/Gameplay

 Quest 013 (and the beginning of the quest 016)
 New Girls' Perk: The Empress's New Clothes
 New Position: Standing Missionary


Thank you for your continued support, we hope you enjoy the new update! 

And if you'd like to get the access to this one, check out our Patreon.

Best, Macamagucha

notes.title: V 0.4.5 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

February is halfway done, and we've finally seen some snow! We hope this message finds you warm and cozy.

We're thrilled to announce that version 0.4.5 of Komadori Inn is now available to our Patrons! This update has been a monumental effort, taking a significant amount of time to complete. We've mentioned in previous posts what to expect in this version, and the final playtest of the new content took me nearly an hour. But that's not all—we conducted a full retest of the entire game, addressing not only the bugs reported by players but also identifying other areas that needed improvement.

With several changes and optimizations, the changelog is quite extensive. As requested by our Patrons, we're keeping it a bit mysterious to avoid spoilers. However, stay tuned for upcoming posts where we'll reveal more details and share a video of the second animated scene from this version.

Changelog

Added:
Story/Gameplay

 "The Events"

 When you complete both quests 007 and 009, the next morning, after the morning meeting, you should have a conversation with an NPC. This will initiate a sequence of events that will unfold over next three days.

 Almost 7000 of new words in dialogue lines.
 Two animated scenes
 Quest 010 + received quests 011, 012, 013, 014 (these four are unfinishable)

World

 Three new maps:

 Hot springs' rest area
 Hot spring's men's change room/bathe
 Third floor (this one is seen only for a few seconds during one of the scenes)


Extras/Art

 Pixel Art of three new characters, dialogue portraits for two of them
 NPC's now enjoying drinks on the benches by the beach

Changed/Fixed

 Fixed crashes while going to the second floor
 Fixed crashes when choosing sex with a girl
 Fixed crashes when eating something from the kitchen pantry
 Fixed volume levels of Sex Sound FX and Shun's Sex VA, Sex BGM volume turned town a notch
 Fixed bugs with some characters switching clothes during Pixel Art scenes
 Fixed bug with girls' dialogue lines not showing after sex or having a talk
 Fixed display of some objects in the rooms switching layers when opening and closing menu
 Girls will have right clothes when choosing sex
 Text rework:

 Typos fixed in English, Polish.
 French and Spanish are now fully translated by awesome people (thank you Reddox, Josema <3)

 Changed the girl placement:

 Fuyuko is now available in the lobby when she's free in the mornings ("Let's talk" available)
 Girls working at the front desk will spend the noon in the office ("Talk" and "Sex" available)
 Shun won't agree to sex at the beach (added other NPC's there)

 Added light to girls' rooms
 Timing of some animations during handjob and missionary positions improved
 Many, many other fixes


Of course, we might have overlooked something or simply haven't tested every possible scenario, so let us know when you come across any bugs or stuff that needs changing!

Please note that quests 011 to 014 are not completable but are received by the player. This approach will help us streamline our work on future versions.

Thank you all for your patience and support. We're continuing our work, and the next version should arrive sooner. However, we plan to participate in the Steam Next Fest as mentioned here and are eager to create a new trailer for the occasion. Let's see how it goes!

Stay tuned, and enjoy the update!

Best,
Macamagucha

notes.title: Version 0.4.3 Uploaded
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our Patrons have just received access to version 0.4.3.

Previous updates brought major changes to the core mechanics of the game, which led to a fair number of serious bugs that were blocking gameplay. While we haven’t eliminated all potential issues, by version 0.4.3, Mugenji has fixed all the bugs you reported to us (as well as many we discovered on our own :D). Thank you so much for every bug report you’ve sent our way. Special thanks to Denivleur, zbuziz, Cucumis and Josema0890 for their detailed bug reports, which helped us resolve some tricky issues!

We’re happy to say that all the planned content has made it into this version—and even a little bit more. There are still some technical tasks to complete, but fewer and fewer of them, meaning that future updates should arrive more frequently. I know, I know, I’ve been saying for a while now that “from now on, we’ll only be working on content,” but we’re still being surprised by how much the game demands from us.

Here’s the changelog for version 0.4.3:

Added:
Story/Gameplay

 Girls' placement system - Instead of always staying in one place, the girls will now be spread out around the hotel, depending on the work we choose for the day. To make it easier to keep track, a table will now appear during job selection, showing where each girl will be placed that day. Additionally they may spend free time in their rooms.
 Additional scene added for Shun after quest 005, where we receive first skill point and quest 009
 Quests

 Quest 007 can be finished now
 Quest 008 (uncompletable, no reward at the end yet)
 Quest 009 (uncompletable, locked on second objective)

 Missionary sex position - after completing quest 007 we receive a skill point for Fuyuko that can be exchanged to unlock next position on the skill map - missionary.

Changed

 Many, many bug fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898267/c4c7693e2d97ff9ad71907ad1566fed33bd7c43f.png
Table you see when selecting your work. In this example you can see that if you choose to work at the reception desk for the day, you'll have a free evening with Fuyuko, while Shun will be tending the bar.

As always we're waiting for your comments and bug reports!

And what’s coming in future version? For sure, we’ll be wrapping up Quest 009, and on top of that, we’re planning a major event that will serve as the conclusion to the first chapter of the game’s story... Stay tuned for more exciting developments!

notes.title: Core changes, V 0.4.2 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Version 0.4.2 has just been made available to our Patrons. We’ve got some good news and some not-so-good news to share.

Let’s start with the bad news: this version still doesn’t include the two quests and scenes we originally planned to have ready. Work on other elements took longer than expected, and since version 0.4.1 had some pretty serious bugs, we didn’t want to keep you waiting any longer for fixes.

Now for the good news! Version 0.4.2 introduces significant changes to several core aspects of the game, making Komadori Inn even more fun to play. Plus, we’re (a little bit) confident this is the last update focused almost entirely on technical improvements. While there are still features we have to refine and add (such as the “room cleaning mini-game”), these are things we can work on in parallel. The focus is finally shifting towards adding content and new scenes!

To give a little sneak peek of what’s coming in the next version (what was planned for this), it will include an intimate kissing scene and a new position for Fuyuko, adding more depth to her storyline and interactions (you can see the kiss in the previous, locked post). Meanwhile, Shun-chan will finally have her first position unlocked (handjob), marking a major milestone for our relationship.

We know it’s been a long journey, but we really want Komadori Inn to feel like an exceptionally enjoyable experience—and we appreciate your patience as we bring it closer to that vision. 

And here's the changelog of v 0.4.2

Changed / Fixed

 Front desk shift

 Changed the layout of the PC with the schedule, and now NPCs ask more varied questions (on weather, hotel information or currency rates)

 Bar shift

 Adaptive tempo - how fast new guests come in depends on how quick is the player mixing the drinks

 Energy system

 Locked nights - at night you go automatically to bed. You need to buy an permanent item from the store to be able to walk around at night (item available after quest 004)
 Full recovery - nights restore your whole energy bar
 Changed energy cost - actions energy cost is more varied. Some actions will also take energy but won't take time
 Work energy cost - the energy required for work will be deducted when you select a job during the morning meeting, so you don’t have to worry about running out of it later.

Bug fixes

 Serious bugs (Whiteboard, Day 1 Front Desk Shift, Picking up the phone, Quest 005, Day 8, Manual Saving - I think that's all)
 Many many other smaller fixes and improvements



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898267/c7bb5b096885a7e1770480806e1a544d3050a1f5.png
 New front desk PC

Let us know your thoughts and feedback—we love hearing from you and shaping the game with your input!

Thank you, as always, for your incredible support and patience. We’re thrilled to have you on this journey with us, and we can’t wait to share even more exciting updates soon. Stay tuned, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Work continues, v 0.4.1 uploaded
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our Patrons have just received access to version 0.4.1.

I don't want it to sound like an excuse, but remember that this is the ALPHA version, so errors and shortcomings are inevitable. Compared to 0.4.0, we've gone from limited time to (almost) complete freedom from day 4, which still requires a lot of work and is a bit clunky at this stage, so I suggest you do nothing more than check out the things we've added now. 

We didn't want to drag out work on this version any longer, so some elements are not yet perfect (and some, of course, are not there at all). In the changelog, I'll try to list what is a temporary solution and what can't be done, so that you also know what to look out for and what you can report to us as a bug or something to improve. 

I can reveal that we are planning a few more changes to the functioning of the basic game mechanics (energy management, sleeping). We believe that thanks to this, "Komadori Inn" will be even more interesting and enjoyable.

*NON-ENGLISH LANGUAGE PLAYERS!!*

Everything up to version 0.4.0 was translated by real human translators. We're using machine translation now just until we gather enough text to hire translators again. Sorry if you will experience poorer quality for some time now.

Love you <3

notes.title: Public Demo and Giveaway Incoming; First look on the Shopkeeper
notes.content:
Hello players!

As previously announced, the big day is approaching, so save the date!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898267/f20819fdd972345bae826d369ba3b142f56a260e.png
 
But that's not all. In addition to giving you the opportunity to try out everything we've created so far, we'll also be launching a giveaway on that day! We will be giving a total of 10 Steam Keys for "Komadori Inn", as well as 3 Steam Gift Cards worth $25 each! You will learn all the details on July 30, so we are counting on your large attendance.

Join our Discord server so you won't miss the chance for those prizes.

Okay, so how's the game going?
Of course, we will publish the complete changelog when version 0.2.0 is released, but suffice it to say that all the most important systems and mechanics have been introduced to the game, and the current content takes about 50 minutes to complete, which in our opinion is quite good for a demo.

We're mainly focused on testing and fixes right now, because even though it's still a beta, we want you to have as much fun with it as possible.

And what next?
The next days bring new adventures for our hero. I can reveal that at the beginning of the third day of the game you will receive as many as three quests and complete freedom in choosing your next actions. And apart from the quests themselves, we also fill the world of "Komadori Inn" with additional possibilities, interesting encounters and new locations.

One of the new places, as you may have already guessed from our polls, will be a store run by Haruka Majima. You helped us decide what our  shopkeeper should look like and this is what we got.

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

our Patrons have just received access to the newest version of "Komadori Inn", labeled V 0.1.2.

This is the second (and probably, hopefully, the last) update that focuses on adding systems and interface modules. It's a bit bigger than we initially planned, even though it doesn't add any game time at all. It's a groundwork for what's coming up next, and now we can finally dedicate our attention to expanding the gameplay.

So, what's in the 0.1.2?
